criteria.requirement: Add sorted_copy(key=None) to SortedList/SortedKeyList, SortedSet and SortedDict. Build a fully independent container of the same logical family using the selected key, preserving members/value identities and natural ordering for None. Original content/order/strategy never change, including when new key raises. Rebind all cached bisect/irange proxies to the new index; retain empty/copy/pickle behavior. SortedList factory may return keyed/unkeyed concrete list type; no subclass constructor guarantee or implicit in-place rekey.
